name: com.crixgamingvr.flappycrix-arcade
description: A playable Flappy Crix arcade cabinet for VR games and Gorilla Tag fan games. Single-player arcade machine (attract mode, free play or coins, high scores with initials) or linked cabinets where players standing nearby race each other, through the room your game already uses - no extra Photon CCU.

samples.description: Races and shared high scores over your PUN 2 room (RaiseEvent, no extra CCU).
Races and shared high scores over your Fusion 2 session (reliable data, no extra CCU).
Gives a fan game's local gorilla arcade fingertips with controller buzz.
